name: Shelly Prosko
reason: Health restore re-check, 13 Nov 2026 (physioyoga.ca home and Online Courses/Videos pages; robots.txt allows us): her own site still defines PhysioYoga as 'an approach to rehabilitation' combining physiotherapy and yoga therapy, presents her first as a physiotherapist, and centres on clinical topics: pelvic-floor health videos (including bladder and bowel function), a Balance Flow Yoga series built for a fall-risk and injury-risk study, pain-care courses and professional mentoring, and her co-edited book Yoga and Science in Pain Care: Treating the Person in Pain (a clinical text). Only one general-population yoga class series (Let's Move, Breathe, Focus + Have Fun) and a self-compassion practice series sit outside rehab and pain care, and both are framed by her clinical experience. Her work is mainly clinical rehabilitation (physiotherapy scope), so she is skipped; no cure claims were the issue.
